## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: sector breadth is weak (≤4/11) and defensive/utility/healthcare names are leading (JNJ ABOVE TREND, VST ABOVE TREND, ABBV ABOVE TREND). Leadership: Broad (Top 5 performers span 5 sectors).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Utilities lead: VST (1W: +5.93% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND and VST driving defensive flows; Financials positive: JPM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +10.28%) ABOVE TREND; Real Estate constructive: DLR (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +1.05%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: Utilities/Financials/Real Estate/Healthcare are the four positives (4/11).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: AAPL (1W: -0.72% | 1M: -3.51%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.46% | 1M: -10.77%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -5.84% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: NFLX (1W: -10.84% | 1M: -18.45%) BELOW TREND; Materials under pressure with DOW (1W: -8.73% | 1M: -14.68%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: TTWO (1W: +12.21% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND, WMB (1W: +6.01% | 1M: -1.51%) RECOVERY, ABBV (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.45%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +5.93% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, DLR (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +1.05%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (Top 5 from 5 different sectors), favor defensive/real-estate/selected cyclicals.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: FCX (1W: -8.17% | 1M: +3.35%) CORRECTION, CHTR (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -11.52%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -8.42% | 1M: -15.96%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -8.73% | 1M: -14.68%) BELOW TREND, CME (1W: -8.95% | 1M: -15.82%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Technology/Comm/Materials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W movers: TTWO (1W: +12.21% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND, WMB (1W: +6.01% | 1M: -1.51%) RECOVERY, CAT (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +13.66%) ABOVE TREND — watch WMB and V (V (1W: +1.44% | 1M: -0.80%) RECOVERY) as short-term reversal candidates (minor divergence).

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech is broadly weak: Technology (1W: -5.47% | 1M: -1.48%) with AAPL (1W: -0.72% | 1M: -3.51%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.46% | 1M: -10.77%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -5.84% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND and ORCL (1W: -14.26% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND; sentiment-driven headlines exist but price action is distribution.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials constructive on the week: Financials (1W: +1.17% | 1M: +4.72%) with JPM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +10.28%) ABOVE TREND and mixed internals (CME (1W: -8.95% | 1M: -15.82%) BELOW TREND). Net: sector leading within a narrow positive cohort.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare holding up defensively: Healthcare (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +1.97%) with ABBV (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.45%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +4.09% | 1M: +3.95%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +1.45% | 1M: +3.77%) ABOVE TREND; watch UNH (1W: -0.44% | 1M: +7.61%) CORRECTION for possible rotation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor defensive/quality names and selective financials: JNJ (1W: +1.45% | 1M: +3.77%) ABOVE TREND, ABBV (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.45%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +5.93% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +10.28%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to large-cap tech/high-multiple names showing uniform weakness (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, ORCL BELOW TREND); style: defensive preference with mixed cyclicals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: TTWO (1W: +12.21% | 1M: +1.92%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +10.28%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +5.39% | 1M: +13.66%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -14.26% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -23.19% | 1M: -28.59%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -10.84% | 1M: -18.45%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Utilities (VST ABOVE TREND) and Financials (JPM ABOVE TREND) — defensive pockets. BEARISH: Technology and Consumer Discretionary remain at risk (NVDA, MSFT, AMZN, TSLA BELOW TREND) given weak 1W momentum.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch tech-confirmation or break: NVDA (1W: -5.84% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND — a failed bounce below the 50-day would accelerate risk; AAPL (1W: -0.72% | 1M: -3.51%) BELOW TREND — hold/violation of recent support to confirm further downside; JPM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +10.28%) ABOVE TREND — keep an eye for continuation above this week’s highs as confirmation of financial leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
CVX (+60): Chevron partnering with Microsoft on Texas AI power project; CVX (1W: -2.45% | 1M: -7.87%) BELOW TREND — sentiment bullish but price diverging. GOOGL (+50): Dow reshuffle headline; GOOGL (1W: -6.29% | 1M: -10.66%) BELOW TREND — positive headline not reflected in price. TSLA (+60): European battery storage deal; TSLA (1W: -7.18% | 1M: -8.67%) BELOW TREND and shows mixed headlines (see bearish item), monitor for sentiment flip.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
ORCL (-50): job cuts and spike in AI spending; ORCL (1W: -14.26% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by sharp price decline. DOW (-50): legal pressure headline; DOW (1W: -8.73% | 1M: -14.68%) BELOW TREND — headline and price align. CME (noted in bottom performers) (1W: -8.95% | 1M: -15.82%) BELOW TREND — institutional/derivatives flow weakness confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with a defensive preference. ABBV (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.45%) ABOVE TREND, VST (1W: +5.93% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +10.28%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: broad tech and high-multiple names remain BELOW TREND and several bullish headlines (CVX, GOOGL) are diverging from price — monitor for distribution.
